rows.note: This is the all-purpose term, especially for an international remittance or the money sent.

example.english: I make a remittance home every month to help with the household expenses.
example.traditional: 我每個月都會匯款返屋企，幫補屋企開支。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 wui5 wui6 fun2 faan1 uk1 kei2 bong1 bou2 uk1 kei2 hoi1 zi1

rows.note: Use this colloquial term for the act of transferring money through a bank or account.

example.english: After you make the remittance to me, send me a photo of the receipt.
example.traditional: 你過數畀我之後，影張收據相片過嚟。
example.jyutping: nei5 gwo3 sou3 bei2 ngo5 zi1 hau6 jing2 zoeng1 sau1 geoi3 soeng3 pin2 gwo3 lai4

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when emphasizing sending money to a person, especially family or someone overseas.

example.english: My older brother sends a remittance to Mum in Hong Kong every month.
example.traditional: 阿哥喺加拿大做嘢，每個月都寄錢返香港畀阿媽。
example.jyutping: aa3 go1 hai2 gaa1 naa4 daai6 zou6 je5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 gei3 cin2 faan2 hoeng1 gong2 bei2 aa3 maa1
